Laurel Hill Fridays

Philadelphia, PA · Road · Social

Women / trans / femme

Laurel Hill Fridays is a road and social group ride in Philadelphia, PA. It rolls every Friday at 6:45 am. Pace: social.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:45 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social.
Check
Look at @laurelhillfridays the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Laurel Hill Fridays group ride

A women-led, WTF-friendly early-morning social ride in Philadelphia. Listed on the Trellis Philly community calendar. Details and the week's meeting point are on Instagram.
